title: Hunter Origin
description:
Become the greatest hunter of them all with the Hunter Origin.

Requires the Origins Mod.
body:
Become the greatest hunter of them all with the Hunter Origin.

Requires the Origins Mod.

Hunter
You grew up in the wild, killing those who pose a threat to you. You have developed a skill set that provides a great advantage when out for prey.

+ Stealth Master: You have become a master of camouflage. Sneaking makes you hidden from other players, but only without armor.
+ Arrow Shot: You have a crossbow hidden away, and can shoot it every few seconds
- Carnivore: Over your years of hunting, you have developed a dependency for meat.
